headline: 1453 · Zurara's Commissioned Chronicle

items.title: 1453 · Ideological Compile
items.detail: Racial narrative commissioned twelve years after the first captive raid.

items.title: Gomes Eanes de Zurara
items.detail: Royal chronicler and Commander of the Military Order of Christ writes the Guinea Chronicle.

items.title: Kendi · First Racial Book
items.detail: Stamped from the Beginning identifies Zurara as assembling one inferior African category.

items.title: Observed Phenotypic Variety
items.detail: Zurara records Lagos captives ranging from near-white to mulatto to black.

items.title: Categorical Degradation
items.detail: Collapses diverse peoples into one group portrayed as living like beasts without law.

items.title: Missionary Salvation Frame
items.detail: Frames the Lagos auction and broken families as missionary salvation.

sources: Zurara (1453); Kendi (2016), Stamped from the Beginning; The Original Power, §2.2 & Ch. 3
